theses.title: Trusted Delegation: When Consumer AI Value Migrates from Generation to Action and Protection (2026–2031)
theses.statement: [THESIS] By 31 December 2031, the dominant source of realized consumer value from AI shifts from content/information generation to delegated action and protection — systems that transact, schedule, cancel, dispute, monitor and defend on the user's behalf — with the binding constraint being verified trust (liability, reversibility, auditability, authentication) rather than model capability. Operationalized as: (a) among adults in high-income markets who use AI at least monthly, a majority name an action/protection use case as their most valuable AI use; and (b) agent-initiated commerce and agent-managed account operations reach material, separately-measurable scale.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Primary remains the April 2027 card-network rulebook release containing an explicit consumer liability and chargeback-parity rule for agent-initiated transactions, with spend ceiling and revocation standard; absence there is a genuine negative update, not noise. Three nearer-term tells inside 90 days: (a) Adobe Analytics' 2026 holiday report — does it disclose agent-originated traffic or GMV as a separate, growing line, and at what base? (b) whether any insurer or reinsurer publicly quotes a priced agent-error product for consumer transactions; (c) whether a top-10 issuer ships an in-app agent with stored payment or account-control authority on by default (BBVA's agent-permissioning deployment is the one to watch as the template). A fourth, now newly relevant: whether consumer-facing agent features survive the current capex squeeze or get quietly deprioritized in Q4/Q1 product roadmaps.

theses.title: Security as Standing Consumption: Resilience Spend Outgrowing Convenience Spend in High-Income Markets by 2032
theses.statement: [thesis] By 31 December 2032, security and resilience spending — enterprise cyber, consumer fraud/identity protection, physical/home security, defense-adjacent and civil-preparedness goods — compounds faster than discretionary convenience spending in high-income markets. Resolution requires at least two of three sub-conditions: (a) [measurable] global enterprise cybersecurity spend grows >10% CAGR over FY2026–FY2032 with no calendar year below +7% y/y, including in any year where total enterprise IT spend grows <2% in nominal USD; (b) [measurable] in nationally representative surveys in the US and at least three EU member states, >50% of adults report currently paying (directly or as an explicitly priced bundle line) for at least one dedicated security, identity, fraud-protection, monitored-alarm or cyber-insurance subscription; (c) [measurable] at least five OECD member states have enacted binding legislation or statutory instruments mandating resilience procurement — strategic stockpiles, backup generation/firm-capacity obligations, or mandatory cybersecurity controls with procurement-linked enforcement — with effective dates on or before 2032.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Palo Alto (mid-November) and CrowdStrike (early December) FY2027 quarters: whether either discloses agent/AI-security as a separate ARR or attach-rate metric, or whether it is folded into platform ARR with no pricing attached. Bundled-with-no-disclosure across both effectively settles the agent-governance leg against the thesis. The decisive test remains unchanged: the FY2027 Gartner/IDC vendor-revenue print reconciled against the IANS/Artico CISO budget benchmark in a year where total nominal IT spend grows <2% \u2014 and with a December hike live and AI capex credit-stressed, that sub-2% IT year has become materially more likely to arrive in 2027 than previously assumed.

theses.title: Reliability as a Purchased Good: Private Substitution for a Degrading Public Power Guarantee (2026–2031)
theses.statement: By 31 December 2031, electricity reliability in the US and EU is behaviourally and commercially treated as a privately purchased good rather than an implicit public guarantee. Operationally: (1) combined annual unit sales of residential/commercial backup generation and storage (standby + portable generators, residential/C&I batteries, solar+storage attach) in the US and EU are at least 2.0x their 2025 level; (2) the share of large-enterprise (Fortune 500 / STOXX 600 industrial + hyperscaler) electricity load covered by behind-the-meter generation or long-term firm-power contracts (LNG-to-power, nuclear PPA, cogeneration, district heat) rises by at least 15 percentage points versus 2025; (3) the trailing-12-month consumer search index for grid-failure/outage-preparedness terms remains at or above 120% of the 2024–2025 mean in every quarter of 2031.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Three in order of diagnostic value. (1) Generac's Q4/FY2026 print in February 2027 on the October resolver was never obtained, so this is now the first hard read on whether C&I/data-centre backlog is outgrowing residential storm demand and whether residential order intake is mean-reverting in a settled 7%-mortgage regime. (2) Whether regulators allocate or socialise data-centre grid cost: watch the next PJM capacity auction, ERCOT large-load interconnection rules, and post-midterm state rate dockets. Successful rate-base capture of AI load (the GEV/Duke/Quanta path) is the cleanest refutation of metric (ii); a ratepayer backlash over socialised cost is the cleanest confirmation. (3) Whether any US state or EU member state introduces mortgage-embedded or on-bill financing for residential resilience hardware on the only identified mechanism that neutralises the rate shock; its absence through 2027 makes metric (i) very hard.

theses.title: Electrons Before Silicon: Power and Siting as the Binding Constraint on AI Capacity by 2031
theses.statement: By 31 December 2031, the operative bottleneck on incremental AI compute capacity in the US/EU shifts from semiconductor supply to electrical generation, interconnection and local siting permission, evidenced jointly by (a) >25% of newly announced hyperscale data-center capacity (MW basis) pairing with dedicated/behind-the-meter generation or non-terrestrial/edge alternatives, (b) >=50 documented local rejections, moratoria or ordinance-based denials of data-center projects in the US/EU citing power or water, and (c) consumer AI inference materially migrating on-device, with >=1 major platform marketing local inference as a cost/privacy feature across >500M active devices.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Priority order over the next two quarters: (1) first hard count from an auditable tracker of US/EU denials or moratoria citing power or water " condition (b) has now gone two months with zero evidentiary progress and is the leg most likely to fail on measurability rather than substance; (2) whether a Nscale/neocloud or vendor-financed GPU counterparty defaults or restructures, which would truncate the announced-MW denominator and make the primary metric uninformative; (3) any FERC or state PUC order that makes behind-the-meter co-location a standard tariffed product rather than a bespoke deal; (4) GPU spot rental rates and HBM contract pricing " these must fall for the silicon-loosening premise to hold, and they have now failed to fall for three consecutive months; (5) evidence on condition (c) that is FLOPs-based rather than query-based, given agentic workloads are re-centralising inference.

theses.title: From Episodic Care to Continuous Metabolic Management and Consumer-Chosen Elective Procedures (2026–2031)
theses.statement: By 31 December 2031, health consumption among adults 40+ in high-income markets measurably re-weights from episodic acute treatment toward (a) chronic pharmacological metabolic management, (b) continuous biometric telemetry, and (c) consumer-researched, device-differentiated elective function-restoring surgery. Operationally: >40m chronic GLP-1/incretin or successor metabolic-therapy users across the US+EU with median persistence >24 months; continuous glucose (or equivalent continuous metabolic biomarker) monitoring used by >50% of diagnosed metabolic patients plus a measurable non-diagnosed wellness cohort; robotic-assisted share of qualifying US elective procedures (inguinal/ventral hernia, benign hysterectomy, radical prostatectomy, total knee/hip) >50%, with documented pre-referral consumer platform research.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Q4 2026 / Q1 2027 real-world persistence readouts (Truveta, Prime, Blue Health Intelligence) against the first four full quarters of oral incretin scripts: 12-month discontinuation below 45% with oral volumes additive rather than substitutive remains the only re-rating event that matters. Secondary and now imminent: post-midterm CMS obesity coverage scope under a hiking Fed and a constrained Congress; DXCM/ABT Q4 disclosure of non-diagnosed Stelo/Lingo users against the 5m threshold; ISRG Q4 procedure growth (deceleration below mid-teens would indicate saturation); SYK/ZB orthopaedic robotic mix specifically in the ASC channel, where the financing squeeze bites hardest.

theses.title: Scarcity Rents in the Physical Layer: Skilled Trades, Infrastructure Credentials and Pre-Economic Robot Adoption (2026–2032)
theses.statement: By 31 December 2032, (a) median real hourly earnings for US/EU electricians, HVAC technicians and pipefitters/steamfitters exceed the all-occupation median by ≥15% on a sustained basis (≥3 consecutive annual observations, 2030–2032), (b) wage returns to infrastructure/cloud/power credentials (e.g. AWS/Azure solution architect, NERC/utility, electrical journeyman-to-master, controls) exceed returns to generic software-development credentials in matched-cohort compensation data, and (c) cumulative commercial deployments of humanoid and construction/jobsite robots exceed 100,000 units globally, with documented early-adopter justification citing labour scarcity, safety and competitive signalling rather than demonstrated payback.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Two discrete tests in the next 8 weeks. (1) The December FOMC: a delivered hike with the 10-year holding above 5% is the condition under which vendor-financed buildout converts from delay to cancellation; watch specifically for the first disclosed data-centre project cancellation or a neocloud/GPU-loan credit event \u2014 either is the fastest route from scarcity rent to crew release. (2) Q4 earnings and 2027 guidance from Comfort Systems, EMCOR, Quanta and Vertiv in late January, where the test is unchanged and still unmet: backlog duration past 18 months, craft labour named as the binding constraint, and explicit field-wage escalation clauses. Secondary: IFR's 2026 World Robotics (does a separate humanoid category appear with five-figure shipments), and the next BLS OES release for the wage-ratio print.

theses.title: Format Absorption: How Housing Unaffordability Is Resolved by Changing the Product, Not the Price
theses.statement: [Hypothesis] By 31 December 2031, US housing unaffordability is absorbed primarily through format substitution rather than restored ownership access. Operationally: (A) the NAR first-time-buyer share of existing-home purchases in the 2031 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers remains below the 2015-2019 average (~32-33%); (B) median new single-family completion size (Census Characteristics of New Housing) in 2031 is below the 2025 level and >12% below the 2015 peak of ~2,467 sq ft; (C) the share of US households containing two or more adult generations (Pew/IPUMS-CPS definition) exceeds 20%; (D) combined manufactured/modular shipments plus dedicated build-to-rent single-family completions exceed 2025's share of total new housing units delivered by at least 3 percentage points. The thesis resolves TRUE if at least three of four conditions hold at year-end 2031.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Two hard reads land inside two weeks and both are decisive rather than incremental. (1) The 2026 NAR Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers, due within days: a third consecutive sub-26% FTB print effectively locks leg A, while any rebound toward 28%+ on the back of record builder price cuts would be the first real evidence that the price channel is resolving affordability. (2) Midterm results on 3 November and the state ballot measures/legislative mandates on institutional single-family ownership — a wave of binding acquisition limits in Sun Belt BTR markets would cap leg D by statute and, with leg C already lost, would break the 3-of-4 arithmetic outright. Secondary: Q4 2026 BTR start counts and manufactured-housing shipments measured against a 5%+ 10-year; shipments holding above 100k proves channel, below 90k proves cycle.

theses.title: Global Rails: 24/7 Tokenised Settlement, Venue Pluralism and the De-Americanisation of Retail Financial Onboarding by 2031
theses.statement: By 31 December 2031, three conditions hold jointly: (a) combined annual on-chain settlement volume in tokenised equities/securities plus stablecoin payment value exceeds US$1trn (excluding pure crypto-native speculative spot trading and exchange-internal wash/inter-affiliate transfers); (b) at least three venues that are neither NYSE nor Nasdaq nor US-domiciled capture measurable and reported primary-listing share (>=1% of global IPO proceeds each) or cross-border payment share (>=1% of global cross-border retail/SME payment value each); and (c) a majority (>50%) of newly opened retail financial relationships worldwide in calendar 2031 (brokerage, wallet, or investment accounts) are opened on platforms not headquartered in the United States.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Unchanged in substance, now with a post-heist overlay: (1) a top-five broker/exchange publishing tokenised-equity volume with named market makers and quoted spreads; (2) the first CCP, prime broker or insurance regulator formally accepting a tokenised money market fund as eligible margin. New near-term tells: whether USDT/USDC supply and redemption flows held par through the Binance withdrawal halt (confirmed par redemption under stress would be the strongest single datapoint available this cycle for the trust prerequisite), whether regulated custody providers publish share gains at exchanges' expense, and whether the next big non-US AI/tech issuer after Anthropic picks HKEX/LSE/Gulf rather than Nasdaq. Downside triggers to watch: a stablecoin issuer caught in the AI-credit or private-credit stress complex, and any SEC narrowing of the exemption at review.

theses.title: The Gerontocratic Balance Sheet: Protection, Advice and Transfer as the Organizing Logic of Household Finance (2026–2031)
theses.statement: By 31 December 2031, household financial behaviour in high-income aging economies (US, UK, EU-5, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia) reorganises around wealth protection and intergenerational transfer rather than accumulation, measurable as four joint conditions: (1) net flows/AUM into guaranteed-income and advice-led wrapped solutions grow at a faster CAGR (2026–2031) than flows into pure passive index funds/ETFs held directly by retail; (2) a majority (>50%) of surveyed adults aged 45–65 report managing, co-managing or advising an aging parent's finances; (3) elder-fraud/scam protection controls (trusted contact, transaction holds, anomaly monitoring, caregiver view-only access) are a default, disclosed feature at >75% of the top-20 retail wealth/brokerage platforms by client assets; (4) aggregate household allocation to scarce physical stores of value (gold, farmland/land, energy/real-asset funds) remains above its 2015–2024 average share of household financial+real assets.
theses.next_confirmation_signal: Primary, now time-critical: Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 LIMRA US individual annuity sales (and Insurance Europe/FCA retirement income data) showing acceleration against record 2024-25 comps in direct response to the AI-complex drawdown. A drawdown of this size at a 5% risk-free rate is the single most favourable environment the thesis will ever get; if annuity and in-plan guaranteed-income flows do NOT visibly inflect in those prints, condition (a) should be treated as rate-driven mean-reversion rather than a behavioural reorganisation, and the thesis loses its strongest leg. Secondary and unchanged: at least two of the top-five US custodians announcing default caregiver view-only permissioning plus AI scam monitoring; if not fired by Q2 2027, condition (c) fails and the composite becomes a 2-of-4 problem. Tertiary: Fed Z.1 Q4 2026 plus WGC household demand showing whether bar-and-coin and retail gold-ETF holdings held through a ~10% price break (allocation) or liquidated with it (price).

scoreboard.note: Brier 0 = perfect, 0.25 = coin flip. Calibration bins compare stated probability with realised frequency; the hindcast harness (forecast from 1995/2000/... with later data hidden) is the next step.
